title: Proper forget-supports normalizes the diagonal section on one scheme
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $f:X\to S$ proper, and $p=p_a:X\times_S X\to X$ either projection. Let $d:X\to X\times_S X$ be the diagonal and use the data of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]. Write $U_X$ for the derived tensor unit, $C_X=A_X[0]$, $c:C_X\cong U_X$ for constantUnit, and $s_a:U_X\to Rp_!Rd_!U_X$ for diagonalUnit. Let $\phi_h:Rh_!\cong Rh_*$ be proper forget-supports [def-sp-unbounded-proper-shriek-star-comparison], and $\eta_h$ the constant-object unit of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system]. For every $K\in D(X_{et},A)$ and $\theta:U_X\to K$, one has $s_a;Rp_!(\phi_{d,U_X}.\mathrm{hom};Rd_*(\theta));\phi_{p,Rd_*K}.\mathrm{hom}=c^{-1};\eta_p;Rp_*(\eta_d);Rp_*Rd_*(c.\mathrm{hom};\theta)$. This is a normalization on one self-product, natural in the coefficient map, with no projective-line isomorphism or exchange map. The proper forget-supports isomorphisms are expressed by ordinaryProperForgetComparison [def-sf-ordinary-proper-forget-comparison], which is the same canonical construction with recorded ordinary endpoints.

source.place: The equation M = Rp2_* Delta_* M, the diagonal is a section for either projection, and substitution of canonical pullback counits before applying direct image.

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-free unit normalization to the tensor unit, then use naturality of both proper forget-supports comparisons and functoriality of ordinary direct image to transport the identity coefficient to an arbitrary map θ. The constantUnit inverse and hom cancel, leaving θ intact.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient-free diagonal section normalization followed by naturality in the coefficient map.

theorem diagonalSection_forgetSupports
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] (a : Bool)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (θ : derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X ⟶ K) :
    diagonalUnit A f a ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (projection f a)).map
          ((ordinaryProperForgetComparison A
              (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).hom.app
                (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
            (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map θ) ≫
        (ordinaryProperForgetComparison A
          (projection f a)).hom.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).obj K) =
      (constantUnit A X).inv ≫ supportedDerivedUnit A (projection f a) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          (supportedDerivedUnit A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map
            ((constantUnit A X).hom ≫ θ))
